outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original fantasy battle animation sprite sheet. Reference Thornwhip Carrier: brown-haired young woman with tied-back hair, green scarf and layered leaf-green skirt, brown leather torso armor, pale seed-shell shoulder/forearm/knee/shin plates tied with red cord, brown boots, strapped round wicker back frame with thorn-vine coils and small amber vials. ONE long brown-green thorny vine whip with red thorns, gold-banded wooden handle in RIGHT hand, LEFT hand holds loose coil only when resting. Twelve full-body articulated poses in FOUR columns THREE rows; generous gutters for whip, constant body/handle/vine length and fixed three-quarter view facing right. Transparent RGBA background. Reading order: 1 relaxed idle handle upright loose loop supported left hand; 2 inhaling idle shoulders lift vine coil sways; 3 walking right foot forward left back; 4 passing right foot planted left knee advances feet close; 5 opposite contact LEFT foot forward RIGHT back torso unchanged; 6 whip windup RIGHT handle back above shoulder vine trails loop behind LEFT hand released coil away safely; 7 lash contact RIGHT arm and handle extended toward right vine follows continuous tapering arc forward, LEFT arm back for balance; 8 defensive crouch handle diagonal left hand gathers vine; 9 struck recoil equipment retained; 10 dying knees buckle vine falls loose; 11 collapse onto side vine rests nearby back frame attached; 12 dead side-lying eyes closed handle beside RIGHT hand one continuous thorn vine coiled on ground and attached wicker frame retained. Exactly one handle and one continuous vine, no extra ropes replacing whip, no detached segments. Same costume and gear in every pose. No labels, background, ground shadow, effects or gore. Detailed original painted strategy art matching reference, real articulated motion not translated duplicates.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY row three column two, kneeling dying Thornwhip Carrier. Remove the SECOND loose gold-banded wooden handle lying at screen right of that pose inside vine loops. Keep the original handle in her RIGHT hand at screen left beside knee. Repair the removed loose handle area to checkerboard empty background and continuous thorn-vine loop only. Exactly ONE whip handle remains. Preserve her body, both hands, equipment, existing held handle and every other sprite unchanged.
